# memax-v2

How memax-v2 is built and run.

## Decisions

- Background jobs run on River, Postgres-backed. We don't use Temporal ("one queue" & <one> DB). [M-0001]
- Everything async goes through one Postgres queue. [M-0001, M-0002]
